research.facts:
WS Game 3 Recap — Brewers 10-1
**Sources consulted:**
- baseball-reference.com (WS G3 box score)
- ESPN, CBS Sports, Fox Sports, CNN, Bleacher Report, Field Level Media coverage
- Previous pipeline notes (Oct 23-26)
**Verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Final score: Milwaukee Brewers 10, Tampa Bay Rays 1
- Game played: Monday, Oct. 26, 2026, Tropicana Field (Game 3 of World Series)
- Brewers lead series 3-0
- Eight-run fifth inning — all eight runs scored with two outs (World Series record for two-out runs in an inning)
- Seven consecutive two-out hits in the fifth inning (World Series record)
- The rally was triggered by an overturned replay review on a Christian Yelich hustle play, leaving bases loaded
- Robert Gasser: 6 IP, 1 H, 0 R (shutout through six)
- Jackson Chourio: 4-for-5, 1 double, 1 stolen base
- Tampa Bay's lone run scored in the ninth inning on an RBI double by Diaz
- Attendance: 40,388 (sellout at Tropicana Field)
- First World Series game at Tropicana since 2008
**Verified facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- William Contreras added three hits in Game 3, raising his postseason total to 18 (most in Milwaukee playoff history per ESPN)
- Chourio became the 26th player with multiple hits in the first three games of a World Series
- Chourio's four hits made him youngest player with 4 WS hits since Joe Garagiola in 1946 (per search results)
- Milwaukee's 10 runs tied franchise record for most in a postseason game (matching Game 1 of 1982 World Series)

research.facts:
No Team Has Come Back from 3-0
**Verified facts (HIGH confidence):**
- No team has ever come back from a 3-0 World Series deficit in MLB history
- Teams with a 3-0 lead have won the World Series every single time (100% win rate historically)
- Most recent team to come back from 2-0 was the 1996 Yankees (prior pipeline note referenced)
**Verified facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- 43 teams (approximately) have led 3-0 in the WS historically and all 43 won
